messages:
kevin (partnerships): Quick sync — LangChain + OrchestratorX requested a coordinated beta and marketplace listing. Proposed timeline: private beta next Tue (6/10), marketplace listing 6/24. Need tech adapter, sample apps, legal/branding signoff, and a demo script. Who can own which pieces?

jessie (devex): I can own SDK samples + quickstart doc updates. Need a canonical prompt + expected outputs from partner.

michael (eng): We need a small gateway shim for OrchestratorX routing (to map their task graph -> our model routing). I'll prototype PR by EOD Fri. Also want an E2E smoke test in orch-ci.

sam (marketing): Heads up — marketing support available. I can draft the joint announcement / blog + landing page copy but need partner logos and 1-2 customer quotes by 6/17.

ana (typo) OOPS — corrected to ana below

ana: ignore previous

ana: (this message deleted)

ana (legal): Please have partners submit logo assets and the signed co-marketing MSA. Legal turnaround is ~3 business days after we have docs. Also we need confirmation they agree to our marketplace terms (I can send).

alisha (marketplace): I can reserve the marketplace slot for 6/24 but need final SKU, pricing tier, short description, and assets by 6/20. Also list size constraints for icons: 256x256 PNG and SVG.

kevin (partnerships): Owner recap: jessie -> samples/docs, michael -> adapter PR + CI smoke test, sam -> announcement + demo script, ana -> legal & branding signoff, alisha -> marketplace listing coordination. I'll sync partners and confirm dates.

jessie (devex): For the quickstart, propose a single-file example that shows: 1) install adapter, 2) register with Redwood, 3) run a sample pipeline. Draft snippet: 

```bash
# install adapter
pip install redwood-orchx-adapter
# run sample
python examples/summary_pipeline.py --input testdoc.txt
```

jessie (devex): I'll also add a small expected-output fixture to avoid flakiness in demos.

michael (eng): Adapter notes: we should support both streaming and non-streaming modes. Also add a fallback mapping to a verified open model if partner capacity limited. I'll put the compatibility matrix in the PR description.

sam (marketing): Demo script idea: 3-min product walkthrough + 5-min partner engineer live Q&A + 2-min customer quote. We should run a dry-run on 6/14. Who's available for dry-run?

kevin (partnerships): Dry-run: 6/14, 10:00 PT. jessie + michael + sam + partner eng. I'll book the slot.

ana (legal): typo again: ana (legal) confirming schedule works for legal review prior to 6/17.

ana (deleted)

ana (deleted)

ana (legal): Also flag: if the partner requires brand co-use beyond the marketplace tiles (e.g., joint press), we need a short approval flow — add that to the marketing checklist.

eng-bot: Reminder created -> #ticket-pt/partnerships/1748529630 created for tracking (assignee: kevin).

alisha (marketplace): One more: marketplace metadata fields we need from partner: one-line summary (<=140 chars), categories (comma separated), homepage URL, support contact email.

jessie (devex): I'll draft the quickstart and sample fixtures by Wed EOD and link in this thread.

michael (eng): PR branch name: orchx/adapter/langchain-orchx. I'll open draft PR and tag this thread.

sam (marketing): I'll put a draft announcement in google drive and ping partner for approvals. Noting we need partner legal OK before publish.

kevin (partnerships): Perfect. Action items and owners are set. If anything blocks, drop notes here. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin (partnerships): Next sync if needed: 6/13 9:00 PT (pre-dry-run).
